# controld_services (Data Source)

Lists the built-in ControlD services and their current action for a profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_services" "home" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile to list services for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source, equal to `profile_id`.
- `services` (Attributes List) The list of services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The service category.
- `do` (Number) The current action for this service: `0` (block), `1` (bypass), `2` (spoof), or `3` (redirect).
- `locations` (List of String) The locations this service can be unlocked in.
- `name` (String) The service identifier (PK), usable as `service` in a `controld_service` resource.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the service action is currently enabled.
- `unlock_location` (String) The unlock location required to bypass geo-restrictions for this service.
